The '''Cheravh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> Contained within the Cheravh [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cheravh]],<ref name="System" /> and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system, along with the surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sector]] came under the control of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following their expanding conquest of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] during their [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Mandalorian Crusaders]].<ref name="TEA" />
